title: Book E-Commerce
description: A description of a book, and a list of affiliate links which can be embedded in a page

title.description: The plain-text title of the book being sold.

subtitle.description: A continuation of the title, also plain text, if the title is long or has a natural break

author.description: The name(s) of the author(s) of the book in plain text. This format is determinded by editorial, and is not controlled by CDS

affiliates.description: A list of vendors and their websites where the book can be obtained.

linkText.description: The display name for the affilate link, like 'Amazon' or 'Find at your Library'.
